provenance.original35: Exact user-authored exposed development prompts from2026-10-31; not held-out.
provenance.new12: Agent-authored new cross-category mission/constraint/paraphrase journeys; not independent human or blind evaluation.

evaluation_policy.decision_unit: Every HTTP response turn including setup is retained. Original target and new turns are also summarized separately.
evaluation_policy.denominator: All scheduled bounded turns; failed service/session/transport and blocked continuations remain in denominator, never removed as unscorable.
evaluation_policy.manual_review: Agent manual content review against predeclared rubrics; explicitly not independent human evaluation.
evaluation_policy.pass_standard: Practical goal advanced, constraints kept, clarification justified, no unsupported claim or irrelevant SKU. HTTP200 or plausible prose alone is insufficient.
evaluation_policy.failure_rule: Service failures cannot pass. Missing independent evidence must not be repaired with invented claims.
evaluation_policy.no_production_case_rules: These rubrics are evaluation data only; do not implement prompt-to-answer or prompt-to-SKU mappings.
